records.field: 好 headword; graphic analysis and cited uses, printed p. 1094 / PDF p. 1109; continuation printed p. 1095 / PDF p. 1110
records.text: The scan shows the actual 好 headword and states that oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States, and Shuowen seal forms are analyzed as 女 plus 子. The author calls the original meaning ‘woman’, then describes extensions to beauty/goodness and the verbal sense ‘like/love’; that discussion continues on printed p. 1095/PDF p. 1110. The passage cites the Shang personal name 婦好 and 《合集》6412. This is the book author's account, not independent proof of the proposed original meaning or of a complete semantic sequence. Printed page numbers are visible in the scans.
